optimizedDescription.value: Pure graph-store query functions computing blast radius, callers/callees, file/spec impact, and risk with deterministic bounded batched traversal.

optimizedContext.value:
# Traversal

## Rules

- `getUpstream`/`getDownstream` traverse CALLS reverse/forward to maxDepth (default 3), results grouped 1-indexed by depth; cycle-safe — symbol reported at shallowest depth only.
- `TraversalOptions`: `maxDepth` (3), `includeFiles` (true → IMPORTS besides CALLS). `TraversalResult`: root, levels `Map<number, SymbolNode[]>`, totalCount, truncated.
- `analyzeImpact(store, target, 'upstream'|'downstream'|'both', maxDepth=3)` → ImpactResult: target, directDependents/indirectDependents/transitiveDependents (depth 1/2/3+), riskLevel, affectedFiles/Symbols/Processes. AffectedSymbol: id, name, filePath, line (1-based), depth.
- Blast-radius edges: CALLS + CONSTRUCTS + USES_TYPE equally; EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS for type symbols; OVERRIDES for methods; COVERS_SYMBOL MAY add affected specs in requirement-aware impact views. All participate in depth counts/risk/file aggregation like call edges.
- Risk thresholds fixed: LOW 0–2 direct & no indirect; MEDIUM 3–5 direct or any indirect; HIGH 6+ direct or 10+ total; CRITICAL 20+ total or target in 3+ execution flows.
- Batched execution: BFS frontiers via GraphStore batch symbol+relation ops — never one request per symbol/relation type; dedupe newly reached ids before single logical fetch. File/multi-file impact, change detection, per-symbol aggregation use fixed bounded concurrency not growing with inputs; multi-file shares one memoized read view + one budget. Must preserve direction, depth, cycles, deterministic ordering, affected sets, covering-spec evidence, dependent counts, risk. Wide graphs MUST NOT fail with `StoreOverloadError`.
- Hotspots: hierarchy signals via ONE `getIncomingSymbolRelations` batch carrying all candidates with EXTENDS+IMPLEMENTS+OVERRIDES, folded in memory into per-symbol counts; never per-candidate queries; score composition/scoped filters/ranking/risk unchanged; wide graphs MUST NOT fail with `StoreOverloadError`.
- `analyzeFileImpact`: findSymbols({filePath}) → per-symbol analyzeImpact → merge: shallowest depth per affected symbol, max risk, union files; hierarchy-derived impact included. `analyzeFilesImpact(filePaths[])`: union files/symbols, sum dependents, overall risk = max across files.
- `analyzeSpecImpact(specId)`: first-class relations DEPENDS_ON (Spec→Spec), COVERS_FILE (Spec→File), COVERS_SYMBOL (Spec→Symbol). Upstream: dependent specs + files/symbols covered by target and transitively affected dependents. Downstream: depended-on specs + reached files/symbols within traversal depth. Result extends ImpactResult; coverage may originate from requirement-aware relations.
- `detectChanges(changedFiles[], maxDepth=3)`: per changed file find symbols → upstream traversal each → aggregate symbols/files/risk/summary.
- Selector resolution: resolve to ONE logical canonical target pre-traversal. Unqualified names: prefer case-exact, else case-insensitive exact; NO prefix/component/textual discovery matches. Unique → traverse; multiple → bounded deterministic ambiguity, no traversal. Qualified/full occurrence selectors exact semantics.
- Public-export impact: accept one public-binding identity, return two explicit views — proven consumers of that exact surface/exported name (incl. downstream re-export chains) AND all dependents of canonical symbol via every route. Retain selected binding, canonical target, ordered binding chain. Ambiguous export MUST NOT merge unrelated candidates or select one.
- Hierarchy traversal preserves edge direction + language precedence (contracts, overrides, inherited members, traits, mixins, embedding, promotion, provable interface satisfaction); cycles terminate; multi-occurrence logical symbol counted once. Deterministic ordering across backends; indexed lookups; bounded cycle-safe traversal.
- `FileImpactResult.coveringSpecs`: deterministic order from reverse COVERS_FILE/COVERS_SYMBOL; each spec once with minimum depth + every distinct evidence `{ kind: 'file'|'symbol', target, depth }`. Input file + its defined symbols = depth 0; reached items use shallowest depth 1..maxDepth. Multi-file: every input file + its symbols depth 0, aggregate evidence, order by min depth → spec id → evidence depth → kind → target. File coverage independently visible without symbol coverage; symbol coverage augments, never gates/replaces. Reverse coverage retrieval batched over deduplicated file/symbol sets. Read-only — projects open-graph coverage; graph-health/freshness consumers own corpus-completeness reporting.

## Constraints

- Stateless pure functions in domain/services/; receive GraphStore read-only — never mutate store, manage lifecycle, or hold state between calls.
- Depth default 3 (TraversalOptions overridable); risk thresholds fixed/not configurable; no dependency on @specd/core.
